neighbours.label: record-setting achievement context, at the slot that predicts 'became / making ... the first' (', making her the first')
fire: In 1963 Tereshkova orbited the Earth forty-eight times, making her the first woman in space.
She swam across the strait in eleven hours, becoming the first person to do it twice.
In 1911 Amundsen reached the South Pole, making his team the first to stand there.
In 2008 the country elected Obama, who became the first Black president.
He won the title again in 2019, making him the first player to win it five times.
In 1953 Hillary and Tenzing became the first climbers to reach the summit.
The probe landed on the far side of the Moon, making China the first nation to do so.
With that victory she became the first woman to win the race outright.
quiet: In 1963 Tereshkova orbited the Earth forty-eight times and then landed safely.
She swam across the strait in eleven hours and slept for a whole day afterwards.
In 1911 Amundsen reached the South Pole and planted a small tent there.
In 2008 the country held an election with very high turnout.
He won the title again in 2019 and celebrated with his family.
In 1953 the climbers rested at the camp before the long descent.
The probe landed on the far side of the Moon and sent back pictures.
With that victory she moved up two places in the rankings.

notes: Card: tokens just before 'the first' in milestone sentences; output promotes become/makes, suppresses 'first'. Probe: ', making him the first' 0.70, plain achievement without milestone 0.01.
